findings.description: The doc comment on `NotesCounts.total` says `Input commits`, but `total` counts only parsed commits; malformed records are left out (see the `malformed` doc). This type is now a public JSON contract (`schemaVersion: 1`), so consumers who read `total` as every input record will expect `shown + ignored + malformed === total`, and that identity never holds.
findings.title: JSON field doc overstates what total counts

evidence.explanation: Lines 72-73 say malformed records are `not part of total`, which contradicts `Input commits` on line 68. The run-4 Qodo comment in evidence/day08/review-4-rerun.json raised the same wording problem, and it was left unapplied.

findings.description: The T-007 row in BACKLOG.md says `built, uncommitted`, but this PR is the commit that delivers it. Once it merges, the backlog will show the ticket as unfinished, and it will not be updated the way T-004 and T-005 were (`done (PR N)`).
findings.title: Backlog shows T-007 as uncommitted after merge
